definitions.gloss: training session; workshop; in-service training; professional development seminar
definitions.explanation: An organized gathering held for education or professional skill development, typically for employees, teachers, medical staff, or members of a group. Differs from a simple meeting ({会議|かいぎ}) in that the primary purpose is learning, not decision-making.

examples.japanese: {研修会|けんしゅうかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧、⟦{新人|しんじん}→新人：02500_shinjin⟧{研修会|けんしゅうかい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Next week there is a training session for new employees.

examples.japanese: ⟦{教員|きょういん}→教員：12942_kyouin⟧{研修会|けんしゅうかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{最新|さいしん}→最新：04831_saishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{学|まな}んだ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: At the teachers' training session, I learned about the latest teaching methods.

examples.japanese: ⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧、⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧{向|む}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{研修会|けんしゅうかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開催|かいさい}している→開催する：10441_kaisaisuru⟧。
examples.english: We hold a training session for employees once a month.

notes:
A broad term for any organized training event. Very common in corporate, educational, and professional contexts. Literally ⟦{研修|けんしゅう}→研修：05322_kenshuu⟧ (training) + ⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧ (gathering).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {研修会|けんしゅうかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: to hold a training session
- {研修会|けんしゅうかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開催|かいさい}する→開催する：10441_kaisaisuru⟧: to hold/organize a training session (more formal)
- {研修会|けんしゅうかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧: to attend a training session
- ⟦{新人|しんじん}→新人：02500_shinjin⟧{研修会|けんしゅうかい}: new employee training
- ⟦{教員|きょういん}→教員：12942_kyouin⟧{研修会|けんしゅうかい}: teacher training session
- ⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧{研修会|けんしゅうかい}: safety training

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{講習会|こうしゅうかい}→講習会：27026_koushuukai⟧: course; training course — typically more structured and curriculum-based, often with an instructor teaching specific content
- ⟦セミナー→セミナー：11000_seminaa⟧: seminar — a borrowed word; often used for academic or business lectures with discussion
- ⟦ワークショップ→ワークショップ：06399_waakushoppu⟧: workshop — emphasizes hands-on, participatory learning
- ⟦{勉強会|べんきょうかい}→勉強会：23197_benkyoukai⟧: study group — more informal, often peer-led

USAGE:
{研修会|けんしゅうかい} is the standard word used in workplace settings. The training can last a few hours, a full day, or several days (a ⟦{泊|と}まりがけ→泊まりがけ：08716_tomarigake⟧⟦{研修|けんしゅう}→研修：05322_kenshuu⟧).
